title: Encouragement
definition: Encouragement is the ministry of strengthening, comforting, urging, and building up others in truth and love.
summary: Believers need encouragement because life includes suffering, temptation, weakness, fear, grief, and weariness. Encouragement helps others keep looking to Christ.
christFocus: Christ comforts and strengthens His people, often through the words and presence of other believers.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Believers need encouragement because life includes suffering, temptation, weakness, fear, grief, and weariness. Encouragement helps others keep looking to Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, think biblically, love others rightly, and live with wisdom, humility, and hope.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your relationships, choices, service, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
